name: What preparations are needed before painting a mobile home?

mainEntity.name: What preparations are needed before painting a mobile home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective preparation is crucial for a lasting mobile home paint job. This involves a thorough cleaning, typically with a power washer, to remove all dirt, grime, mold, and loose paint. Any damaged or rotten siding and trim must be repaired or replaced. Loose caulk should be removed and new caulk applied where necessary, especially around windows and doors. All surfaces should be completely dry before priming and painting. Proper preparation ensures good adhesion of the new paint and a smooth, durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation includes pressure washing, repairing damaged siding/trim, re-caulking, and ensuring all surfaces are clean and dry.
